query: SELECT pct.id, pct.maxiprod_id, pct.ticked_by, FROM_UNIXTIME(pct.ticked_at/1000) as ticked_date, ap.fornecedor, ap.referenteA, ap.valorLiquido, ap.vencimentoData FROM payment_calendar_ticks pct LEFT JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.maxiprodId = pct.maxiprod_id ORDER BY pct.ticked_at DESC;
